blog-hero.looks: A blog-style page opening on a pale wash: title in a wide left column with the author, date and tag pills under it, an optional intro, and an optional navy side panel to the right with a heading, text and buttons.
blog-hero.use: At the top of a blog page, or any page that should open like a blog. On a blog page the blank title, author, date and tags fill in from the blog itself.

fields.heroTitle: The page title; leave blank on a blog page.
fields.heroIntro: Optional: one or two sentences under the title.
fields.heroTags: Optional comma-separated labels, e.g. 'Prevention, Online Safety'; blank on a blog page shows its own tags.
fields.panelTitle: Short side panel heading, e.g. 'Need help now?'. Any side panel field makes the panel show.
fields.panelText: One or two short paragraphs; the first shows larger and bold.
fields.panelPrimaryText: The panel's main button words, e.g. 'Report to the CyberTipline'.
